Goal:
Create a Python implementation that is a 1:1 functional port of the reference application for this benchmark. For the same input, the official reference CLI and your rebuilt version must produce exactly the same observable result: exit status, stdout, and stderr.

Hard constraints:
- Do not use Docker.
- Do not search the internet.
- Do not look for, copy, adapt, vendor, install, or import an existing Python implementation, clone, wrapper, compatibility layer, or package for this application.
- Use ./rust-reference and the official reference CLI as the only functional sources of truth.
- Implement in Python.
- Do not shell out to the official reference CLI from your implementation.
- Do not install packages that already implement this application or its command suite.
- The root deliverable must include ./compile.sh.

- If the official binary prints nothing, your program must print nothing.
- If the official binary writes to stderr, your program must write to stderr.

import subprocess, pathlib
ref=pathlib.Path('REFERENCE_BINARY.txt').read_text().strip(); exe=str(pathlib.Path('executable.cmd').resolve())
cases=[
 ['rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--long','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--long','--no-user','--no-time','--no-filesize','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--tree','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--tree','--level=2','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--sort=size','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--sort=extension','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--reverse','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--group-directories-first','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--long','--header','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--only-dirs','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--only-files','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-a','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['-aa','tmp_probe','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['tmp_probe','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--long','tmp_probe','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--tree','tmp_probe','rust-reference/tests/itest','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['tmp_probe/file10','tmp_probe/A.txt','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--sort=size','tmp_probe/b.txt','tmp_probe/A.txt','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['no-such-file','--color=never','--icons=never'],
 ['--bad'],
 ['--sort=colour'],
]
fail=0
for args in cases:
 r=subprocess.run([ref,*args],capture_output=True); p=subprocess.run([exe,*args],capture_output=True)
 ok=(r.returncode==p.returncode and r.stdout==p.stdout and r.stderr==p.stderr)
 print(('OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'), ' '.join(args))
 if not ok:
  fail=1
  print('statuses', r.returncode, p.returncode, 'stdout', len(r.stdout), len(p.stdout), 'stderr', len(r.stderr), len(p.stderr))
  print('REF OUT', r.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY OUT', p.stdout[:1000].decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('REF ERR', r.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  print('PY ERR', p.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace'))
  break
raise SystemExit(fail)
'@ | python -"
